mapper.select: SELECT id, job_uid, report_id, report_title_snapshot, title_search_key, stage, attempt, status, model_name, input_size, output_size, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, error_code, error_message_short, trace_id, created_at FROM report_ingest_stage_event WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, job_uid, report_id, report_title_snapshot, title_search_key, stage, attempt, status, model_name, input_size, output_size, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, error_code, error_message_short, trace_id, created_at FROM report_ingest_stage_event WHERE title_search_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
